# Requirements Quality Checklist: Design System & Foundation

**Purpose**: Deep validation of requirement quality — completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, and coverage across spec.md, plan.md, contracts/components.md, and data-model.md
**Created**: 2026-02-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are all design token categories (color, typography, spacing, shadow, border-radius, transition) explicitly enumerated in requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are loading/skeleton state requirements defined for ALL base components (Button, Card, Input, Badge), not just Button? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are error state requirements specified for the Input component (validation errors, aria-invalid)? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are requirements defined for the disabled state visual appearance of ALL interactive components? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009..FR-012]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are requirements specified for sidebar content on "generation and settings pages" mentioned in FR-020, or is this explicitly deferred? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK006 - Are requirements defined for the credits badge data source (mock value, format, overflow behavior for large numbers)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are requirements defined for the user avatar/profile dropdown behavior (menu items, actions, sign-out)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK008 - Are z-index layering requirements defined for overlapping elements (navbar, sidebar overlay, mobile menu, glow orbs, modals)? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK009 - Are requirements defined for transition behavior during theme switching (which properties animate, which change instantly)? [Completeness, Spec §SC-003]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK010 - Is "glass-blur background effect" in FR-017 quantified with specific blur radius, saturation, and opacity values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is "smooth delay" for glow orb mouse tracking in FR-021 quantified with specific spring stiffness/damping or timing values? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is "under 5 minutes" in SC-001 measurable given it depends on network speed and system configuration? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK013 - Is "within 2 minutes" in SC-009 measurable and does it define the prerequisite developer skill level? [Clarity, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK014 - Are Button variant names in FR-009 specified precisely ("primary, secondary, ghost, danger") or is this an approximation allowing implementation flexibility? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK015 - Is "at least four semantic variants" in FR-012 sufficient, or should exact variant set be specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK016 - Is "elevation change" in FR-010 Card hover defined with specific shadow values or translateY distance? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK017 - Is "clear focus indication" in FR-011 defined with specific ring width, color, and offset? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK018 - Do Button variant names align between spec.md ("primary, secondary, ghost, danger") and contracts/components.md ("default, secondary, ghost, destructive, outline" — 5 variants, different names)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-009 vs contracts]
- [ ] CHK019 - Do Badge variant counts align between spec.md ("at least four: primary, success, warning, neutral") and contracts ("default, secondary, destructive, outline, success, warning" — 6 variants, different names)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-012 vs contracts]
- [ ] CHK020 - Is the font CSS variable naming consistent between fonts.ts (--font-space-grotesk, --font-inter, --font-jetbrains-mono) and data-model.md semantic aliases (--font-heading, --font-body, --font-code)? Are both levels documented? [Consistency, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK021 - Are border-radius values consistent between data-model.md (buttons: 12px, cards: 16px) and the base --radius value (0.625rem = 10px) from shadcn/ui? Is the override relationship documented? [Consistency, data-model.md]
- [ ] CHK022 - Is the sidebar max-width specified in contracts (360px) but absent from data-model.md? Are both sources reconciled? [Consistency, contracts vs data-model]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are navigation tab labels consistently defined in one language? spec.md uses English ("Dashboard, Templates, Projects"), contracts/data-model use Russian. Is the language rule explicit? [Consistency, Spec §FR-015 vs Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK024 - Is SC-003 "theme switch under 300ms" defined with start/end measurement points (toggle click event to final repaint complete)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK025 - Is SC-007 "LCP under 2.5s" specified with measurement conditions (network throttling, device type, cold/warm cache, geographic location)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK026 - Is SC-004 "WCAG 2.1 AA contrast ratios" accompanied by a list of specific token pairs that must be validated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK027 - Is SC-010 "without creating custom one-off styles" objectively verifiable — what constitutes a "one-off style" vs. a legitimate page-specific layout? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are acceptance scenarios for US1-US4 testable by automation or only by manual inspection? Is the expected verification method documented? [Measurability, Spec §US1..US4]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK029 - Are requirements defined for the scenario where a user has JavaScript disabled? Edge cases mention it but no FR provides explicit requirements. [Coverage, Edge Case]
- [ ] CHK030 - Are requirements defined for simultaneous interactions (e.g., theme toggle during page navigation)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK031 - Are requirements defined for the mobile hamburger menu interaction with sidebar (can both be open simultaneously)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK032 - Are requirements defined for the /dev/components page exclusion from production builds? Assumption says "not exposed" but no FR implements it. [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK033 - Are requirements defined for RTL layout support or its explicit exclusion? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK034 - Are focus trap requirements explicitly defined for the mobile menu overlay, including return-focus behavior on close? [Coverage, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK035 - Are requirements defined for animation behavior during client-side page transitions (reset, persist, or cross-fade)? [Coverage, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK036 - Are requirements defined for theme persistence when localStorage is unavailable (private/incognito browsing)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK037 - Are requirements defined for navbar behavior when the window is resized across the 768px breakpoint with the mobile menu already open? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK038 - Are requirements defined for Button loading + disabled state precedence (which visual state wins)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK039 - Are requirements defined for Card hover animation on touch devices where hover state doesn't exist? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK040 - Are requirements defined for text overflow in navbar tabs, badges, or button labels (truncation, wrapping, min-width)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK041 - Are requirements defined for multiple glow orbs overlapping (blending mode, visual clipping)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-021]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK042 - Are bundle size requirements or JavaScript budgets defined for the design system assets? [Non-Functional, Gap]
- [ ] CHK043 - Is the font loading strategy specified beyond "avoid layout shift" — preload directives, font-display value, subset optimization? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK044 - Are CSS custom property fallback values required for browsers that don't support oklch color space? [Non-Functional, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK045 - Is the 60fps animation performance target from plan.md reflected in spec.md as a formal requirement? [Non-Functional, Gap — plan.md only]
- [ ] CHK046 - Are memory/CPU impact requirements defined for continuous glow orb animations (requestAnimationFrame, spring physics)? [Non-Functional, Gap]
- [ ] CHK047 - Are SSR/hydration requirements defined for client-only components (theme toggle, animations) to avoid hydration mismatch? [Non-Functional, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK048 - Is the "mock data only" assumption validated — are there implicit API dependencies (credits count, user profile data, navigation items)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK049 - Is next-themes compatibility with Next.js 16 and React 19 documented as a known risk with a fallback plan? [Dependency, research.md]
- [ ] CHK050 - Is the Tailwind CSS v4 migration path documented, given v4 has breaking changes in configuration vs v3? [Dependency, research.md]
- [ ] CHK051 - Is the assumption that shadcn/ui components can be fully customized without forking validated against all contract requirements? [Assumption]
- [ ] CHK052 - Are cross-module dependency requirements defined — what exports from this design system must future modules (auth, dashboard, templates) consume? [Dependency, Spec §SC-010]
